steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Muelsyse...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Urgh... nngh...

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I never expected to see you here.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Sorry.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Sorry...?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I would have killed you if the Doctor didn't warn me.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Is that what the enemy wanted? Did they want you to murder your former colleague?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Not necessarily.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: It wasn't just because of the Doctor that I stayed my hand.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: She said, 'Don't be too eager to make an enemy of anyone.' She was alluding to Muelsyse.

options: She was guiding us to Muelsyse.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: She wanted us to find her?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: But one wrong move, and we might've killed Muelsyse...

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Alright, I get it. She doesn't care if Muelsyse lives or dies.

options: She's treating this as a test.
She wants Saria to act quicker.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: A test of the power armor technology, and a test to see how Rhodes Island and I react.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Every word she said in the bar was calculated to probe my response.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: She's guiding us in the direction that she wants.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Ugh...!

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Feeling better, Muelsyse?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You were injected with a sedative a few hours ago, but you'd regained consciousness by the time we saw you in the power armor.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: The nausea and numbness that you feel are mainly lingering effects of hypoxia and extreme stress.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I patched you up a little, but it'll take you another half hour or so to fully recover.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Stop... stop...

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Stop?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Stop... who?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: The one who put you in the power armor?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: The Liberi?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: No...
Muelsyse begins sweating from her brow and the back of her hand.
She grabs your hand, and the drops of sweat rise into the air, splashing against your clothing.
The stain quickly spreads to form a message.
It is not the name of the Liberi, nor of Ferdinand.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Site 359.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Not often I see you here.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: You did give me a temporary work permit, didn't you?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: 'Bibliology consultant'. What's a tech firm like Rhine need with that?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: You're in a good mood. I take it your experiments are going well?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Don't talk about experiments right now.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Ten minutes. A man like me only gets ten minutes to himself a day.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I could spend it on a video call with the children, or dinner with Elena and the others.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: But I prefer to spend it doing nothing but standing here and watching.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: It's just an ordinary street out there.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Yes. It's everything.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: They must be tired after a long day of work. Why is there no sign of dejection on their faces? Why are their steps so springy?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Because they have a chance.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: They believe their hard work is giving them a chance at better lives for them and their families.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Just like those Pioneers outside the city.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Yes, them too.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Trimounts. The city of three burdenbeasts.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Three burdenbeasts carried seven Pioneers to build the first settlement on this soil.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: And now? Look at the streets below.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: The Pioneers and their descendants bring a constant stream of vitality to this place. No other country can claim to rival Columbia's enterprising spirit.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Our country's prosperity has given people confidence, which in turn feeds into our vitality.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: If the country keeps advancing, so will the lives of everyone across all the lands.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I know what you think of me. You, Kristen, Saria... you call me an opportunist.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: It takes a smart man to take a chance when he comes across it.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I can't deny that I would rather be up here than down there.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: But I've earned the chances I've been given.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: My projects have generated wealth, which fed into the next project, and driven technological progress.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: We stand on the cutting edge, leading Terra into a new era.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: They will build monuments, and our names will be immortalized upon them.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Our?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Victory belongs to each and every trailblazer.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: My ten minutes are almost up.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: You didn't give me any time to talk.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I know what you came for, Ho'olheyak.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I forgive you.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Kristen, Muelsyse, Saria, Parvis... and you. I'm not wasting my time trying to guess your petty little thoughts.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Dorothy's experiments are one step away from success.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: All I care about is the final result.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: S-Sonny...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Dorothy says we're safe here... why do you have your crossbows out?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Safe?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You're not stupid, Doctor.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: The biggest danger is right there.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: ...Dorothy?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I thought you were willing to hear us out?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I'm sorry.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Out of the way, you and the other docs. We're not here for you.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: We've been tricked, Elena.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Stopping the attack on Joyce was just a show.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: He showed us his anger, his hesitation, and his bottom line, all of this to hide one thing.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: He was always prepared to commit a crime.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I didn't think it'd be Myers. The whole part of making you trust me... especially Dr. Urbica... I was gonna make Sam play the bad guy.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: But that's all behind us now.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: We're here, right at the source.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: You planned the kidnapping and came all the way here to kill me?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: May I ask... why?
A voice so soft it could melt the hardest heart.
Watery eyes opened slightly wide.
Filled with innocence, surprise, even hurt.
As though it was those who picked up arms to defend themselves who should be reproached.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Why? You can still ask why?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I saw it all.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: The monsters you made, stalking us. How you fed them the blood of my friends.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You... evil...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: There are no monsters!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Those are byproducts of the experiments, made of a special material that's sensitive to neural signals...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: No, Elena. He's not making a blind guess.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: It really does seem like he's seen those silver things before.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: And more.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Three days ago, I snuck into the lab complex to find you.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I wanted to ask if I could volunteer to be a test subject.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Sir! Didn't you say it was too risky? That the corps could be lying to us?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Risky? Haha... hahaha!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Sorry, Sam. I was the one lying.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: But I wanted to fix my mistakes.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Listen, everybody.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I saw silver monsters taking shape around her that night. She talked to them like they were her pets.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Dorothy Franks is the one behind all this.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Do you find it hard to accept what I'm telling you?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Can't say I'm into sci-fi.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Then maybe you could take a look at this letter.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Letter?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Mr. Sonny gave it to me. He might've known he'd be in danger.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: He said to me, and I quote, 'Give this letter to Mary Banner if anything happens to me.'

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: I'm sure he wouldn't mind you reading it... a little early.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Give it to me.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Er... what does it say?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Where the hell did that guy go?!

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You don't know Sonny Romano, Greyy.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: He's a ball of anger and hate, all over his insurance.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Insurance again...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Yes, every Infected in Columbia deals with that word a lot.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: People outside think Columbia is kind enough to the Infected.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You get to live a normal life, as long as you can pay for your health insurance. That sounds pretty darned fair, doesn't it?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: That's what Sonny told me when he first got sick.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: But where did that end up?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Was it... very expensive?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: On a cop's salary? I couldn't afford it, even if I quit eating altogether.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: It wasn't meant to ensure keeping the Infected healthy. The premiums are way out of line with the treatment they actually get.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: It's more like a fine. Or a little trick that forces the Infected to go down a certain path.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Sonny Romano never wanted to face the truth.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: If he's not stopped, he could end up going down a path you don't come back from.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: What you saw were neither monsters nor pets.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: But they do have something to do with my experiments.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: So you admit it.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: The truth will do you no good.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: The more you know, the more danger you're in.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: People up high always like to make decisions for the little guy.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Why don't you put down those pointy things? My instruments can be fragile.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Or if you have to aim, aim this way.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I don't mind.
She takes a step towards the Pioneers, almost touching the crossbows.
Sonny's hand trembles ever so slightly. He forces himself to look away from that warm pair of eyes.
This is a ploy. A trick to get them to submit again.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Aren't you afraid to die?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I am.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: But I'm more afraid that you'll hurt yourselves.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: You're not a murderer, Sonny, and neither are your friends. You're just ordinary men, trying to live better lives.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Didn't you consider participating in my experiments?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: You still have a chance. Join us, and you'll get what you've always wanted.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I'll never turn you down.
She extends a hand to the Pioneers, as though waiting for them to clasp it.
Does she not understand that they came to kill her?
No. Don't look at her. Her eyes, her hands, they're too soft and warm.
They, the people who walk the barrenlands, have never known anything but cold refusal from the cities and those who live in them.
She is controlling them, like she controlled the others whose wills were weak.
But, the word 'chance'...
When was the last time we heard it?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It's those silver constructs!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Where did they come from? I didn't see...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Sonny... was right.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: This lab is where they were born.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: They're protecting Dorothy.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Stop. Don't hurt each other...

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: It's coming!

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: More over there!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Look out!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Grab Dorothy Franks—no, destroy the lab!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: We gotta destroy this cradle of evil to stop the monsters, once and for all!

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: That is the one thing that I will not permit.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: The experiments must continue.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: It was my promise to you... to them.
